description.en: Registers the visibility of a handle at a given step/key of the HQ event system initialized by CMND_HQ_EVENT_INIT, so an actor can be shown or hidden at specific points of the scripted cutscene.
Step/key index within the HQ event sequence.
1 to show the handle at that step, 0 to hide it.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).
